Definition: a primary word; to twine or braid:--plait.
BiblicalUsage: Pleko means to plait, to braid. The soldiers plaited a crown of thorns and put it on Jesus in John 19:2, and again in Matthew 27:29 and Mark 15:17 — the same cruel braiding in all three Gospels.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe men braided thorns for a crown, and God made it the crown of the King.
